daily_load_assessment: Immediate training stress is currently negligible (ATL 6.6, TSB +6.3). With no recorded workouts over the last 5 days and zero fatigue accumulation today, your body is completely fresh and fully cleared for training stress.
acute_status_assessment_3_weeks: Over the past 21 days, training volume has dropped severely to just 2 running sessions (totaling 1.0 hour and 71 TSS). This acute undertraining has caused significant fitness detraining, dropping your CTL down to 12.9. You are well below your structural baseline, requiring immediate re-engagement to restart adaptation.
sport_trend_assessment_6_months: The 6-month macro trend shows a steep decline from strong spring/summer cycling blocks (where daily loads exceeded 150-250 TSS) down to your current CTL of 12.9. Reaching your goal CTL of 60 requires a disciplined, steady ramp rate of +1.0 to +2.0 CTL per week through strict adherence to the 70/30 pyramidal distribution.
coach_verdict: Execute Priority 1 today. Because acute training volume has been extremely low for three weeks, jumping straight into maximal VO2max intervals risks tendon strain and excessive soreness. Priority 1 establishes the consistent Zone 2 aerobic volume needed to safely trigger your CTL ramp while sharpening turnover with short strides.

priority_1.session_title: Aerobic Base Re-Entry Run + Speed Strides
priority_1.workout_details: 10 min warm-up walk/easy jog. 45 min steady Zone 2 run at conversation pace. Finish with 4 x 15-second relaxed speed strides (accelerating to 90% effort with full 45s walk rest between effort reps). 5 min cool-down walk.
priority_1.reason: Highest priority. Re-engages your running engine and builds base volume to ramp CTL after a 5-day pause, while neuromuscular strides prime running economy for upcoming 5km interval work.

priority_2.workout_details: 15 min Zone 2 warm-up with 3x30s high-cadence spins. Main Set: 3 x 8 min @ 230W (Sweet Spot) with 3 min Zone 1 recovery between sets. 10 min easy cool-down.
priority_2.reason: Second priority. TSB is positive (+6.3), allowing you to absorb targeted cycling load to support your 20-min power goal without generating destructive fatigue.

priority_3.workout_details: Barbell Back Squats: 4x6 @ 75kg. Barbell Bench Press: 3x8 @ 60kg. Heavy Sandbag Carry: 3x40m (70kg). Kettlebell Swings: 3x15 (20kg). Hanging Leg Raises: 3x12.
priority_3.reason: Third priority. Provides sport-specific force production for cycling torque and running stride power, alongside core stability and upper-body aesthetics.
